Name: GooLiPack
Author: gaegoolinae
Description:
This mod is a [b]light-touch character texture refinement[/b] that stays as close as possible to the original [b]vanilla Stardew Valley[/b] art style.
All changes are made through [b]pixel-level adjustments only[/b], focusing on refining facial proportions, eye balance, and small details.
No redesigns, no stylistic overhauls — the original character identity, colors, shading, and atmosphere are intentionally preserved.
This mod is designed for players who enjoy the vanilla look, but prefer slightly cleaner and more polished portraits without breaking immersion.
